# Jamaica Observer

> Jamaica's leading news organization covering politics, sports, business, and lifestyle with digital subscriptions and premium content.

Jamaica Observer is a major Caribbean news outlet providing comprehensive coverage of Jamaican politics, elections, sports, and cultural events. The site offers digital subscriptions, special event coverage, and lifestyle content including food awards and fashion promotions.

## Key Topics

- Jamaica politics
- Mark Golding

- Kingston

- Annual events
- Jamaica media

## News & Politics

- [Jamaica Observer - Elections](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/elections): Jamaica elections coverage hub featuring PNP, JLP, and political analysis
- [Bring case to ICJ for Melissa damage, says Golding](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/03/18/bring-case-icj-melissa-damage-says-golding): Mark Golding proposes ICJ case for Hurricane Melissa climate compensation
- [Plug the leaks!](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/03/18/plug-the-leaks): Opposition Leader Mark Golding on tax compliance and budget debate
